primitive-token-use.description: Implementation consumes primitive Design Distillation variables instead of semantic roles.

arbitrary-color.description: A literal color bypasses the semantic color contract.

arbitrary-spacing.description: A spacing declaration uses a raw dimension instead of the shared token system.

arbitrary-radius.description: A border radius uses a raw dimension instead of the shared radius contract.

arbitrary-typography.description: Typography uses a raw size/spacing value outside the semantic type contract.

unjustified-gradient.description: Gradient treatment conflicts with a restrained profile or an explicit avoid rule.

unjustified-backdrop-effect.description: Backdrop blur/filter adds visual complexity not supported by the profile.

unjustified-shadow.description: Raw shadow usage conflicts with a low-depth design profile.

mixed-icon-families.description: Multiple icon-library families are imported in the audited source.

excessive-surface-nesting.description: Card/panel/surface wrappers are nested beyond the configured threshold.

missing-primary-heading.description: A heading hierarchy exists but no h1 was found in the audited source.

skipped-heading-level.description: Static heading markup skips a level in reading order.

missing-pattern-state.description: A prioritized UX pattern lacks a recognizable implementation signal.

image-missing-alt.description: A static img element has no alt attribute.

focus-outline-suppressed.description: CSS suppresses focus outlines without a detectable replacement on the same declaration line.

input-accessible-name-review.description: A static input has no detectable label association or aria accessible name.

missing-reduced-motion-path.description: Motion declarations exist without a prefers-reduced-motion path; severity becomes error when reduced motion is required.
